Create profile setup screen `app/(tabs)/(progresso)/profile.tsx` with form for all fields
Validation: name required, heightCm 140-220, currentWeightKg 40-180, gender required
Add 'profile' screen to `app/(tabs)/(progresso)/_layout.tsx` stack navigator
If profile not filled (name or gender missing), show prompt/redirect to profile setup from progresso index
Remove hardcoded ATHLETE_NAME, ATHLETE_AGE, ATHLETE_HEIGHT, ATHLETE_PHASE exports from usePhysiqueStore.ts
Update services/physiqueAnalysis.ts to import and read from useAthleteStore.getState() instead of constants
Typecheck passes (`npx tsc --noEmit`)

userStories.title: Category Finder calculation logic with tests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a pure TypeScript function that calculates all eligible IFBB/NPC categories for any athlete profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `services/categoryFinder.ts` with exported function `findCategories(input: CategoryFinderInput): CategoryResult[]`
CategoryFinderInput type: { gender: 'male' | 'female', heightCm: number, currentWeightKg: number }
CategoryResult type: { name: string, className: string, eligible: boolean, maxWeightKg: number | null, deltaKg: number | null, status: '✅' | '⚠️' | '❌', statusText: string }

Male categories (6): Men's Physique (classes A-F by height, no weight limit), Muscular Men's Physique (Open, no weight limit), Classic Physique (classes A-E, formula: (height-100)+bonus where bonus is 4/6/8/11/13 per class), Classic Bodybuilding (classes A-E, formula: (height-100)+bonus where bonus is 2/4/6/8/10), Bodybuilding IFBB (classes by height), Bodybuilding NPC (classes by weight in lbs)
Female categories (7): Bikini (A-H by height), Wellness (A-D), Figure (A-D), Women's Physique (A-B), Bodybuilding (by weight in lbs), Bodyfitness (A-D), Fit Model (A-F by height)
Status logic: ✅ if currentWeight <= maxWeight or no weight limit, ⚠️ if 0 < delta <= 5kg, ❌ if delta > 5kg

Export category metadata constants: MALE_CATEGORIES and FEMALE_CATEGORIES arrays with full data per category (poses, attire, judgingCriteria top 5, musculatureLevel, conditioningLevel, summary string)

Each category constant includes: name, classes array, poses array, attire string, judgingCriteria string[], musculatureLevel ('leve'|'moderado'|'moderado-alto'|'alto'|'extremo'), conditioningLevel ('moderado'|'moderado-definido'|'definido'|'definido-seco'|'seco'|'extremo'), summary string

Create `services/__tests__/categoryFinder.test.ts` with tests: male 172cm/85kg returns correct classes for all 6 categories, female 165cm/60kg returns correct classes for all 7 categories, Classic Physique weight formula edge cases (exactly at limit, 1kg over, 5kg over, 6kg over), all female categories return ✅ for height-only categories
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Use data from docs/physique-check-product-prompt.md for all category tables, classes, formulas, poses, attire, and judging criteria. This is the source of truth.

userStories.title: System prompt v3 with all 13 categories
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the updated system prompt with complete IFBB/NPC data for all categories so Claude can analyze any athlete.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace SYSTEM_PROMPT in services/physiqueAnalysis.ts with v3 based on docs/physique-check-product-prompt.md
Prompt defines role as 'copiloto de progresso' — educational, NOT a coach. Does NOT prescribe diet, supplements, cardio, or specific training
Includes explicit limitations section: lighting changes everything, angle deceives, photo ≠ stage, pump/meal/hydration affect appearance
Includes complete data for all 13 categories (6 male + 7 female) with classes, weight formulas, poses, attire, judging criteria
Analysis protocol uses 6 blocks: (1) Resumo, (2) Avaliação por grupo with fit de categoria, (3) Comparativo visual, (4) Recomendação de categoria, (5) Posing, (6) Ações da semana
Fit indicators use exactly 3 levels: ✅ No nível, 📈 Acima, 📉 Abaixo (remove ⚖️ NO LIMITE from current prompt)
General classification: 🟢 Destaque, 🟡 Adequado, 🔴 Atenção
Athlete context interpolated dynamically from useAthleteStore: name, gender, height, weight, phase, coach
Only include categories matching athlete's gender in the prompt (don't send female categories for male athlete)
JSON scores block preserved at end: overallConditioning (1-10), stageReadiness (qualitative), vTaper (1-10)
Rules: respond in athlete's language, honest about limitations, max 3 categories per analysis, use relative language
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The full prompt content is in docs/physique-check-product-prompt.md under '## System Prompt'. Adapt it to use template literals for athlete context.

userStories.title: Expo API Route proxy for Claude API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to move the Claude API call server-side so the API key is not exposed in the client bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `app/api/analyze+api.ts` as Expo API Route

Accepts POST with JSON body: { photos: { base64: string, label: string }[], context: AnalysisContext, athleteProfile: { name: string, gender: string, heightCm: number, currentWeightKg: number, phase?: string, coachName?: string } }
Validates payload: at least 1 photo, name and gender present, heightCm and currentWeightKg are numbers
Reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from process.env
Model configurable via ANTHROPIC_MODEL env var, defaults to 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'
Builds Claude API request with system prompt + user prompt + images (same logic currently in analyzePhysique)
Returns JSON: { analysis: string, scores?: PhysiqueScores } on success, { error: string } with appropriate HTTP status on failure
Update services/physiqueAnalysis.ts: analyzePhysique() now POSTs to '/api/analyze' instead of 'api.anthropic.com' directly
Remove import of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from client-side code (services/physiqueAnalysis.ts)
Remove or deprecate constants/api.ts if it only contained the API key
Timeout: 90s on the client fetch, API route itself allows up to 120s for Claude response
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Expo API Routes require EAS Hosting or `npx expo start` dev server. Verify deployment story.
